summary: Review webhook/event-consumer code for authenticity boundaries, duplicate delivery, ordering, retries, replay safety and idempotent side effects.

must_inspect.why: Event authenticity must be checked before attacker-controlled payloads reach privileged side effects.
false_positive_guards: Do not assume missing verification in one handler if enforced by a verified upstream gateway.

must_inspect.why: At-least-once delivery requires a deliberate duplicate/replay strategy around side effects.
false_positive_guards: Do not call duplicate handling absent from a local function if enforced transactionally downstream.

must_inspect.why: Retry and ordering semantics can corrupt state when handlers assume exactly-once/in-order delivery.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand global ordering if the domain invariant does not require it.
Static code cannot prove provider delivery semantics.
